long_biography.plain_text:
After studying at Western University, Yeh spent years building technology businesses before entering Bitcoin markets in 2013. At Binary Financial he traded for funds, family offices and wealthy clients, developed an institutional liquidity service and invested in cryptocurrency infrastructure. His early combination of technical knowledge, proprietary trading and over-the-counter execution established the foundation of his investment career.

Yeh founded Abu Dhabi-based Quantum Fintech Group and concentrated its strategy around the Fantom ecosystem. He and his team assumed control of Tomb Finance during its 2021 crisis, then extended the project into Lif3, a multi-chain decentralized-finance platform, and L3 Reserve. Across these ventures he combined fund management, seed investing and direct project stewardship, making digital assets—not his earlier technology work—the durable source of his public business identity.

No audited fund statement, regulatory filing or dependable personal-net-worth breakdown was found, so these figures are neither repeated as fact nor used to establish wealth classification.

Self-made is selected because the documented causal platform consists of Yeh's technology entrepreneurship, cryptocurrency trading, fund management and direct project investment.
